title: Trading enumerations
description: Order-related enumerations shared by the REST API and events.

OrderIntent.description: What the user intends. SHORT opens or increases a short position.

BrokerSide.description: Side sent to the broker (a SHORT intent is submitted as SELL).

OrderStatus.description: Order lifecycle status. Terminal: FILLED, CANCELLED, REJECTED, FAILED. UNKNOWN means the broker outcome is uncertain and is resolved by reconciliation, never by automatic resubmission.
